items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: "I identified them as the date in which Hilton Jefferson and Oscar Pettiford and O.C. Johnson were on this tape."

ctx.x: Yes, but I'm not sure. But when I see these other titles listed here -- "All Sweet Mystery of Life," "Turtle Dove" and "I Didn't Know About You," "I'm Coming Virginia," "St. Louis Blues," "When Your Love Has Gone" -- I identified them as the date in which Hilton Jefferson and Oscar Pettiford and O.C. Johnson were on this tape.
I've never heard these -- an album if it was ever released, with these songs on it. So
